title: Messages stuck at the bottom of the chat — the note inside the bubble

steps.path: A message the app never hears back about, 30 seconds after sending
steps.headline: "Not sure this was sent" is now the bottom of the message bubble: full width, amber, light Dismiss left, dark Send again right.
steps.changed: The separate amber box under the message moved inside the bubble as a tinted strip across its full width. The ✕ is gone; Dismiss is a light outlined button, and Send again is the dark filled one at the far right.
steps.notice: The note reads as part of the message it is about. The bubble grows taller by the strip while the note shows.
steps.risk: Two new button styles were added for buttons that sit on the bubble's colour (the app's usual ones were invisible or off-colour there); they are used nowhere else yet.

steps.path: A message the computer says it never received (a phone that lost its connection mid-send)
steps.headline: "This didn't send" gets the same strip inside the bubble, in red, with Discard and Send again.
steps.changed: Same move for the red note: inside the bubble, full width, light Discard on the left, dark Send again on the right.
steps.notice: Amber means maybe, red means definitely not; both now live in the message itself.

steps.path: The same notes in the Light theme, where the message bubble is dark
steps.headline: On a dark bubble (Light theme) the colours flip: the strip is a deep amber or red and Send again turns light.
steps.changed: Send again always takes the colour that contrasts with the bubble, so it is white here rather than dark. The red version looks the same way with a deep red strip.
steps.notice: "Dark Send again" holds on light bubbles (Midnight, Dark, YouCoded Night); on dark bubbles (Light, Crème, YouCoded) it is the light one, so it never disappears into the bubble.
steps.risk: If you want Send again dark on every theme, it would need a fixed colour that may clash with some theme packs.
